pages.title: Stellar Singularity
pages.text: Birth, life and death of a star, from protostar to remnant, in one point of light that never dims. Holding it is like holding a star's whole history: the warmth of fusion, the swelling of a giant and the cold heaviness of collapse, all at once and all faint.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I loaded the Compressor with every stage of stellar evolution I had produced, from protostar core to supernova remnant. The stages merged into one luminous point that remembered all of them.
